annotations.title: The maturity wall: facilities maturing inside a window

description: Debt facilities still on a BDC schedule whose tagged or written maturity falls inside the window (default the next 24 months from today), ordered by date: borrower, sponsor with basis, lien, principal held (a lower bound), mark on cost, the BDCs holding it. Filter by sponsor, lien and minimum principal. A BDC that tags no maturity contributes nothing here.
